title: Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB stories vs MongoDB and MySQL stories on points
question: Does a story about Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB get more points than a story about MongoDB and MySQL?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB gets more points than a story about MongoDB and MySQL.
expect: If true, points per story for Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB stories should be at least 1.5x the value for MongoDB and MySQL stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB against MongoDB and MySQL

group_a.label: Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h302 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h302 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
